entries.basis: Accepted public API/migration review identifies incompatible removals/default changes and actual major markers. Actual339c958d message hash matches accepted commitlint/analyzer proof and is an ancestor of dev. Configured analyzer returns major; maintained pure tool tests prove initial1.0.0 versus existing1.4.2→2.0.0 and0.9.0→1.0.0 for both supported breaking syntaxes, without editing versions or deciding publication authority.
entries.criterion: - [ ] A-R-15 Reconcile original `R-15`: Mark breaking public API removals appropriately; if a release already exists, migration needs a major bump, while a first publication follows the configured initial-release policy. Historical status: open.

entries.basis: Safe validation calls only configured commit analyzer and installed pure next-version helper; six release-policy and14workflow-policy tests pass. Root release forwards to packages/ui; config branches and release push/guard are main-only and release requires full reusable validation. Dev integration cannot trigger release; an approved main promotion can publish after validation and is documented accordingly. Source hashes prove release config/workflows/manifests unchanged; no lifecycle/dry-run/publish hooks invoked.
entries.criterion: - [ ] A-R-28 Reconcile original `R-28`: Validate release configuration safely without publishing while implementing it; explicitly control whether final migration merges will trigger the first public release or a subsequent major release. Historical status: open.

limits: Pure synthetic prior-version inputs establish tool behavior, not authoritative publication history. Read-only empty GitHub tag/release observations and public npm404 do not certify private/deleted history or rights. No main promotion, version edit, dispatch, tag or publish action. R17 authority, R27 effective protection, legal and final-candidate checks remain separate.
